name: cortextech
description: The cortextech brand: a blue brain-loop mark (brain-x) and the full logo, the mark plus the 'cortex tech' wordmark with 'tech' in a solid box.

logos.full-logomark.svg: Full logo for dark backgrounds: white wordmark, 'tech' cut out of a white box, transparent around it.
logos.full-logomark-white-bg.svg: Full logo for white backgrounds: black wordmark, 'tech' in a black box, on a white rectangle (shows as a white panel on any other color).
logos.brain-x.svg: The mark alone, transparent; blue, so it works on light and dark backgrounds. Use it where the full logo would be too wide (small corners, avatars, app icons).
logos.brain-x-white-bg.svg: The mark alone on a white square.
